channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon Quick now lets you build custom apps with natural language -
item.description: Now generally available, Amazon Quick lets you build custom applications by simply describing them in natural language. Create project trackers, customer dashboards, and training portals in minutes instead of months. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports sharing job bundles
item.description: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports sharing job bundles, giving teams a simple way to distribute and reuse render job templates without manual file distribution. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights now supports self-managed PostgreSQL
item.description: Today, AWS announces support for self-managed PostgreSQL databases in Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports a dry run feature to validate API requests
item.description: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports a dry run feature to check whether an API request would succeed without executing the operation. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Backup now supports protecting more than 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets per account
item.description: AWS Backup now supports backup and restore of more than 1,000 Amazon S3 buckets per account, matching the Amazon S3 bucket quota configured for your account. Previously, AWS Backup for Amazon S3 supported up to 1,000 buckets per account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer dashboards now support compact mode
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer now offers compact mode on the analytics dashboards, increasing data density so supervisors can see more of their operational data without scrolling. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Adds Optional OAuth Scopes, Letting Developers Mark What Users May Decline
item.description: Cloudflare has added optional OAuth scopes, letting client owners mark which permissions users may deselect at consent. The company names MCP servers as the motivating case, since agents request the union of everything they might do. (1 source: infoq)
